recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision changes Questionnaire code search-parameter naming or semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-22685 asked for Questionnaire.code to be searchable because the historical Questionnaire code search parameter only searched Questionnaire.item.code. The final resolution was to drop code and add questionnaire-code for Questionnaire.code, item-code for Questionnaire.item.code, and combo-code for both.
initial_application: Commit 50e453775ef3cf19e1ee233ba60ff2f5963d61c0, referenced in the Jira comment, split source/questionnaire/bundle-Questionnaire-search-params.xml from the old Questionnaire-code/code definition into the three named search parameters. Later refactors changed surrounding metadata and FHIRPath style but preserved the split parameters.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Questionnaire search-parameter bundle is current build source. A Zulip Questionnaire thread after approval points to J#22685 and describes the same planned replacement; direct Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-22685 record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because source/questionnaire/bundle-Questionnaire-search-params.xml already contains questionnaire-code, item-code, and combo-code with expressions for Questionnaire.code, Questionnaire.repeat(item).code, and their union, and it no longer contains a legacy Questionnaire code SearchParameter.
